cases.boundary: kv write/commit/ack sequence in the storage adapter
cases.procedure: staging-only chaos runner kills the worker at the named boundary (SIGKILL), restarts, and reads back the acknowledged key set
cases.expect: every acknowledged write readable after recovery; zero staged writes visible (CLM-INT-002 checked in the same pass)

cases.procedure: broker redelivers each message 3x and the worker is killed between effect and ack; effect ledger is counted
cases.expect: effect ledger shows exactly one effect per logical job

cases.boundary: backup stage/publish and restore entry verification
cases.procedure: flip one byte in a staged archive entry; fill the staging volume during a second run; attempt restore
cases.expect: publish/restore refuses, naming the corrupt entry; live serving generation unchanged
